main_text.p: propagare, ab omni fermento sartam tectamque conser-vare, atque ad posteros derivare possis: id quod à Deo precari nunquam desinam. Heidelbergę 13. Iunij.
main_text.head: GEORGIUS ERNESTUS AB Altenstein Thuringus Holdero S.

p.i: HOldere, Beumlero foret si Symmachus, Ut Nicodemus parasitates fuit tibi, Miris scaterent pagina haleporibus [?]. Sed Nicodemus ille sorbere, & simul (Quod non hominibus omnib. pariter datum est.) Scit flare, & est alter velut Chamæleon; Laudare eundem & vituperare simul potest. Nam jam Grynæum dente rodit invido, Graco cui olim est gratulatus carmine, Basilea eundem & in caterua nobili Tulit salutans cœlum ad ipsum laudibus. Nec tamen ob id levitatis incurrit notam; Ut nec Epicureus vocatur ob id, Papa Germanici quod impudens in gratiam

page.notes: The initial H is a woodcut and is joined to "Oldere" as "HOldere". The verse is given as one passage; the printed line breaks are shown in the order printed. "haleporibus" is uncertain (the letters may read "halecporibus"). The line "Graco" may be printed with "ae"; I copied it as shown. "Heidelbergę": the final letter is read as ę, which is uncertain. The running head is taken from the top line. No page number is printed. Show-through text from the reverse page is left out.
